    OWO Planner

    Personal planner for tasks, habits, finances, journal and reminders

    What is OWO Planner?

    OWO Planner is a personal planner app that helps you organize your day in one place. The app is developed by OWO Studio.

    Instead of juggling separate apps for to-dos, habits, budgets and notes, OWO Planner brings everything together in one calm, simple space. Open it in the morning to see what your day looks like, check things off as you go, and close the day with a few lines in your journal.

    What's inside

    • Tasks and calendar: plan tasks and events by date;
    • Habits: build and track daily habits;
    • Finances: keep a simple record of your income and expenses;
    • Journal: notes and a daily self-observation diary;
    • Reminders: notifications at the time you choose;
    • Photo of the day: keep one photo for each day.

    Why OWO Planner

    Everything you need for a well-organized day, without the clutter.

    Everything in one place

    Tasks, habits, money and notes live side by side, so you don't need to switch between apps.

    Simple and calm

    A clean, friendly interface that puts what matters today in front of you.

    Your data stays yours

    Sync goes through your own Google Drive, in a hidden app folder. No ads, no selling your data.

    Never miss what matters

    Set reminders for the time that suits you and let the app do the remembering.

    How OWO Planner helps you

    Plan

    Write down tasks and events and put them on the calendar, so your day has a clear shape.

    Build habits

    Mark your daily habits and watch your consistency grow, day by day.

    Reflect

    Whether you want to get organized, stay on top of your budget or simply look after yourself with a daily journal, OWO Planner gives you the tools in one app.

    How the app uses Google Sign-In

    Tap me to expand this window

    You can sign in to OWO Planner with your Google Account. Google Sign-In is used only for two things:

    • to identify your account by your email address;
    • to sync your planner data between your devices by saving a backup in the app's hidden data folder in your Google Drive (drive.appdata permission). The app cannot see or change any other files in your Drive.

    Your data stays in your own Google account. We do not sell it, do not use it for advertising and do not share it with third parties. OWO Planner does not use Google APIs to generate or process images.

    OWO Planner's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
